systems.country_label: numérisation des procédures d'octroi des permis de construire via le portail « Khadematy »
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Modernisation of the Administration, with the ministries of housing, state property and decentralisation
systems.tiers: the municipalities of the three Nouakchott wilayas only, from 12 March 2026; procedures elsewhere unchanged pending generalisation; tariff approved by Nouakchott's municipal councils

note: Reports the launch on 12 March 2026 of online building-permit applications for residents of Nouakchott's municipalities on the national Khadematy portal, with files processed by 'the authorities concerned'; it does not say a commune office works in the system or is connected, so the service is noted and gives no fact.
